provider: First Integrity Title Agency (independent title/escrow agency; Phoenix, AZ [Maricopa County], 5100 N 99th Ave Suite 112) — via the TRACcalculator platform (comparetitlecompanies.com/get_quote/, operated by TI Services, LLC)
endpointOrParams: Plain server-rendered PHP multi-step form (from_step/next_step wizard, no JS/SPA), driven via POST with a requests.Session() cookie jar. Step 1: POST county/city/transaction-type selection (counties_id=599 for Maricopa, city_town_id=4369 for Phoenix -- both values discoverable via the same host's plain-GET AJAX endpoints, e.g. GET /get_quote/ajax_get_cities.php?state=AZ&counties_id=599, no auth). Step 2: POST property_types_id=1 (Single Family), q2_amt=500000 (purchase price), q4_amt=400000 (1st mortgage amount), addlq_48=2 (Lien Payoff Involved: No). Step 3 returns the full itemized Detailed Title Quote / TRID Loan Estimate inline in the same response.
scenario: $500,000 purchase price / $400,000 loan amount, Single Family residential, Sale transaction, Phoenix/Maricopa County (AZ's most populous county). Underwriter shown: Stewart Title Company.
methodology: Discovered via First Integrity Title's own website, which embeds this calculator in an <iframe>. The form requires no personal data at all -- the only free-text field ('Prepared By') was left blank, and the property 'Address' field (required) was filled with a non-identifying place-name value ('Phoenix, AZ') rather than a fabricated street address, consistent with the hard rule against entering fabricated personal information. No login/registration was required at any step.

bundlingNotes: Major platform discovery this session: TRACcalculator (a.k.a. CompareTitleCompanies.com), operated by TI Services, LLC (tiservicesllc.com), is a nationwide title-industry SaaS subscription product -- comparable in scope to MyTitleRates.com -- licensed to individual title agencies (each with its own numeric title_co_id) and to at least one state-branded consumer comparison portal (comparetitlecompanies.com itself, which markets to Colorado consumers). This session confirmed the entire quote wizard is plain server-rendered PHP with a session-cookie-based multi-step POST flow -- no JavaScript execution needed -- a strong new lead for other 'scarce' states. Escrow/closing fee ($675) is notably lower than the two AZ independents already on file for the published-schedule survey (Pioneer Title Agency $1,342 and Arizona Escrow & Financial $1,250 at the $500k tier for their combined/bundled escrow product), but First Integrity's fee structure unbundles far more granularly (separate Transaction Fee, Loan Tie-in Fee, Notary Fee, CPL all itemized independently) rather than bundling wire/courier/doc-prep into one number the way Pioneer and AEFC do -- a genuine structural difference, not necessarily a lower total cost once all line items are summed ($675+$100+$150+$100+$20 = $1,045 buyer-side closing-services subtotal, within range of the bundled competitors).

provider: Arizona Premier Title (independent title agency; Scottsdale, AZ [Maricopa County], 7669 E Pinnacle Peak Rd Suite #120) - via app.netsheetcalc.com/TitleTap platform, app_id 546
endpointOrParams: TitleTap's newer (2026) 'Quick Quote' backend, distinct from the app_id-numeric non-auth-ajax.php?action=getAppData recipe documented for the VA/IN/KY/AR TitleTap tenants in earlier sessions (that action name 404s on this newer tenant). Config fetched via plain unauthenticated GET: https://app.netsheetcalc.com/company/non-auth-ajax.php?action=getNetSheetConfig&app_id=546 -- returns the full fee-form schema as JSON per scenario type (seller/cash/finance/refinance), including flat-dollar constants and price-tiered-rate formulas referencing named rate-table keys. Price-tiered rates (escrow/closing fee split, owner's and lender's title insurance premiums) are resolved via a second plain GET: https://app.netsheetcalc.com/api/index.php/rate/<amount>/<rate-key>, e.g. rate/500000/ClosingFee546 (total escrow fee at $500k, split 50/50 buyer/seller per the config's own division-by-2 formula), rate/500000/MPPCOwner546 (Owner's Title Insurance, Maricopa/Pima/Pinal County tier), rate/400000/MPPCLoan546 (Lender's simultaneous-issue Title Insurance at $400k loan). No form submission, browser, or JS execution needed -- both endpoints are plain GET with no personal data fields anywhere in the schema.
